newsitem.title: USA: Hooper Holmes sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Hooper Holmes sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Hooper Holmes Inc said its board has declared a two-for-one stock split, record August 22, payable September 5.
The stock split will increase the total number of shares outstanding to about 13.8 million.

Chairman Jim McNamee said, "The Company has shown strong operating results and consistent earnings growth over the past several quarters. This, coupled with our solid cash position, supports the board's decision to declare this stock split and increase the dividend."
"As the industry leader, we are optimistic about our future growth and believe, as additional distribution channels for life insurance develop, we are well positioned to benefit from these trends."
